body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Psychic Damage; impose -1 on its next Success Die if it repeats the Combat Card it used most recently until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The penalty also applies if it selects the same target again.
On a hit, it is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Fracture
rider.html: If you accepted Strain and the target repeats that card before your next turn, it is Slowed 1 until your next turn after resolving the card.
